updates.note: Management re-stated the EBITDA margin band expectation of 18% to 20% for the year.
updates.quote: We believe as we go forward, for the year we should be able to maintain the band of what we have spoken of 18% to 20%.

updates.note: Management guided for volume growth of about 8% to 9% going forward.
updates.quote: we feel that it would be reasonable to expect to see a volume growth of about 8% to 9% going forward.

updates.note: Management confirmed that the VAE facility was started in September, delivering the H1 FY27 target.
updates.quote: in September we started our VAE facility and this is something which has been implemented in a record time

updates.note: Reiterated the 150 KT capacity for phase one to be utilized next year.
updates.quote: with the full capacity of 150 KT we should be able to utilize in the next year.
